text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @sre-oncall — High streaming tail latency detected for /v1/stream (hosted). p95 = 1.4s (SLO 300ms), p99 = 4.8s. Error-rate of SSE connections elevated (~0.7%). Root traces attached.

sre-oncall: ACK. pulling dashboards and traces now. tagging team channels. what regions affected?

eng-runtime: looks like us-east-1 only so far. inference node CPU/GPU okay; KV cache hit-rate stable. problem appears between proxy -> client path (lots of stalled writes).

eng-proxy: seeing a backlog: proxy write queue depth spiking, many connections in "waiting for client ack" state. also elevated TIME_WAIT sockets. small % 502s when upstream closes.

frontend-eng: customer reports: SSE connections hang then reconnect. some clients see 15-30s stalls.

sre-oncall: timeline: p95 climb started ~10:02 UTC. any config rollouts around that time?

eng-runtime: there was a rollout of traffic-smoothing keepalive/backoff at 10:01 by traffic-smoothing service.

ops-manager: who initiated that rollout? @product-ops ?

product-ops: that was an automated staged rollout. pausing and rolling back now. initiating rollback to previous keepalive on all proxies.

eng-proxy: mitigation plan proposal: 1) rollback keepalive/backoff change, 2) increase proxy upstream chunk timeout to 30s, 3) enable immediate chunk flush on write boundaries, 4) apply per-connection rate limiting to slow consumers. applying 1 now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback completed by traffic-smoothing (deploy id: ts-rollback-20260314-01) at 10:10 UTC.

sre-oncall: monitoring metrics after rollback — p95 dropped a bit but p99 still elevated. collecting end-to-end traces for stuck connections.

eng-runtime: traces indicate write buffers accumulating on proxy -> client side. many clients aren't reading quickly (likely CDN / mobile slow consumer). proxy holds chunks until TCP window opens; that blocks other streaming work (head-of-line effect).

frontend-eng: can we mitigate by changing chunking behavior and per-connection buffering? suggestion: reduce chunk size, flush more frequently, enforce soft per-connection throughput cap.

eng-proxy: implemented: reduced chunk size to 4KB and enabled immediate flush on chunk boundaries. added temporary per-connection rate limit 256kb/s for long-lived streams.

sre-oncall: monitoring… p99 dropped 4.8s -> 1.2s within ~3 minutes. p95 back under the 300ms SLO. good signal.

customer-success: compiled list of top 5 customers affected. reaching out with status note and ETA for postmortem.

ops-manager: confirmed customer impact: degraded UX (stalls, reconnects) for subset of streaming clients in us-east-1; no data loss observed, reconnects restored sessions.

frontend-eng: log snippet from proxy:
```
proxy: stalled_chunk_write client_id=xyz12 bytes=4096 err=EPIPE
conn_state: waiting_for_client_ack > 12s queue_depth=42
```

eng-runtime: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) add alert for proxy write-queue depth and per-connection stall time, 2) instrument client-side ack latency, 3) re-evaluate keepalive/backoff rollout tests, 4) investigate CDN/middlebox slow-consumer behavior and potential handshake with partners.

sre-oncall: will handoff follow-ups to @eng-runtime. documenting mitigation steps, timeline, and customers contacted in incident ticket.

eng-runtime: ack — I'll own the follow-ups and postmortem. plan to add automatic mitigation to reduce chunk-size when downstream write stalls detected.

customer-success: sending a status update to affected customers now; will include mitigation, timelines, and contact for escalation.

sre-oncall: handoff: oncall shift ending. leaving notes and runbook entry for similar future incidents. recommend adding a rolling canary for keepalive/backoff changes.

ops-manager: thanks all. default incident status -> resolved for p95/p99 at 10:25 UTC pending postmortem review.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (p95/p99 within SLO). Creating incident record and attaching traces. :white_check_mark:
